Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004, 005, 006 or 007 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. This checkpoint changes testing travel only. Cerulean’s campaign conversion moves to prototype 0021. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Route 4 has a two-way return opening toward Mt. Moon. Buy HM02 Fly for zero Pokédollars at Celadon Department Store’s third-floor TM counter, teach it to a compatible Pokémon, then use Fly outdoors without a badge. Native visited-city destinations and other field restrictions remain. These Fly conveniences stay enabled during testing. All prototype 0019 features carry forward; back up your normal save before switching. Emulator save states stay with their exact ROM version. Earlier patch pages remain available separately.
